subject: A resignation is not an apology, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Energy Minister resigned this week rather than answer for how farming families have been treated by her department. That is not justice. It is an exit.

The laws she wrote are still in place. Her department is still using the same tactics on the same families: uninvited attempts to get onto farms, security brought to an elderly farmer's door, and Greg Baldwin charged after ringing triple zero about trespassers on his own land, until the DPP withdrew every charge on 27 April 2026.

You lead this government now, so this now sits with you. I am asking you to do two things.

Apologise to the farming families your government targeted.

Order an independent investigation into how it happened.

And if you believe farmers were never targeted, then say exactly that, on the record, over your own name. One or the other, Premier. Silence is no longer available.

Yours sincerely,

subject: She resigned. The system she built did not.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Lily D'Ambrosio is gone. Everything she built is still standing.

The access powers are still law. The department is still run on the same playbook that farmers across Victoria have been describing for months: turning up uninvited, pressing an elderly landholder with security in tow, and a farmer, Greg Baldwin, charged for calling triple zero about trespassers on his own farm. The DPP withdrew every one of those charges on 27 April 2026.

A minister leaving the building does not settle any of that. You are the Premier. It is yours now.

Apologise to the families. Order an independent investigation into the targeting of farmers. Or, if your government's position is that no farmer was ever targeted, put that denial in writing so Victorians can weigh it against what farmers say happened.

I would like your answer on the record.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Two options, Premier: deny it on the record, or investigate it
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

This is a simple letter with a simple structure, because the question is simple.

Either your government targeted farmers, or it did not.

If it did not, tell Victorians so plainly, over your own signature, and stand behind that denial.

If it did, then farming families are owed an apology from the Premier and an independent investigation into how their own government came to treat them this way.

What you cannot do is what your former Energy Minister did: leave without answering. Her resignation this week resolved nothing. The laws remain, the department remains, and the families remain, including Greg Baldwin, who was charged after ringing triple zero about trespassers on his own farm before the DPP withdrew every charge on 27 April 2026.

Choose, Premier. In writing.

Yours sincerely,

subject: The apology farmers are owed is now yours to give
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

When a minister resigns without apologising, the debt does not leave with her. It passes to the government she served. That means it passes to you.

Farming families in this state have described uninvited attempts to get onto their land, security personnel brought to the door of a farmer in his eighties, and consultation that counted their refusals as agreement. Greg Baldwin rang triple zero about trespassers on his own farm and was the one charged. On 27 April 2026 the DPP withdrew every charge.

More than one hundred thousand Australians have joined the campaign asking for this to be put right. A resignation is not putting it right.

Apologise to the families. Order an independent investigation. Or state on the record that farmers were never targeted, and let that statement sit alongside their accounts.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Premier, your department is still doing it
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

I am writing to you rather than your new Energy Minister because this is bigger than one portfolio.

The conduct farmers have described did not resign this week. The laws that enabled it are still in force. The department that carried it out still reports to your government. Nothing about the way farming families are being treated on their own land has changed except the name on one office door.

Greg Baldwin was charged after calling triple zero about trespassers on his own farm. Every charge was withdrawn by the DPP on 27 April 2026. Other families tell of uninvited visits and of security brought to an elderly farmer's home. None of them has ever received an apology.

So I am asking the head of the government, directly: apologise, and order an independent investigation into the targeting of farmers. If you believe there was no targeting, deny it in writing instead.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Don't inherit her silence, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your former Energy Minister had every opportunity to answer one question: did her department target farmers? She never answered it. This week she resigned instead.

You now have a choice about what you inherit. You can inherit her silence, or you can end it.

Ending it looks like this: an apology to the farming families who were put through it, and an independent investigation into how uninvited access attempts, security escorts to an elderly farmer's door, and the charging of Greg Baldwin for ringing triple zero on his own land were ever allowed to happen. The DPP withdrew every charge against Mr Baldwin on 27 April 2026. There was never a case.

If your answer is that none of this amounts to targeting, say so on the record and Victorians can judge.

Which is it, Premier?

Yours sincerely,

subject: 100,000 Australians are waiting on two words
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

More than one hundred thousand Australians have joined the campaign standing behind Victorian farming families. This week the Energy Minister who built the system they were fighting resigned. Not one of those families has heard the two words that matter: we apologise.

A resignation without an apology is an escape, not an answer. And the powers she legislated are still being used by a department your government runs.

As Premier, you can settle this properly. Apologise to the families affected. Order an independent investigation into the targeting of farmers, including how Greg Baldwin came to be charged after ringing triple zero about trespassers on his own farm, before the DPP withdrew every charge on 27 April 2026.

Or reject it all, in writing, under your own name: farmers were never targeted. If you will not write that sentence, Premier, ask yourself why.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Farmers are still afraid to call the police, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

There are farmers in Victoria who hesitate to ring the police when strangers come onto their land. They saw what happened to Greg Baldwin, who made that call and was the one charged, until the DPP withdrew every charge on 27 April 2026.

That fear did not resign this week. It is still out there in the paddocks, along with the access powers your government legislated and the department that used them.

Restoring trust starts with honesty from the top. Apologise to the farming families who were targeted. Order an independent investigation so it cannot happen again. Or tell Victorians, on the record, that no farmer was ever targeted, and stand behind that statement when the families tell their stories.

You are the Premier. This is now yours to fix or yours to own.

Yours sincerely,

subject: One minister gone. One question left.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

The minister who wrote the laws is gone. The question she refused to answer is still on the table, and it is now addressed to you.

Did your government target farmers?

If no: write it down, sign it, and release it. A clear denial from the Premier, on the record.

If yes, or if you cannot honestly write that denial: apologise to the farming families involved and order an independent investigation with the power to examine how uninvited access attempts, security at an elderly farmer's door, and the failed prosecution of Greg Baldwin were allowed to occur. Every charge against Mr Baldwin was withdrawn by the DPP on 27 April 2026.

A resignation was never the demand. The truth is the demand. Please answer it.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Finish this properly, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

I will keep this short, because thousands of us are writing and the ask has not changed.

Your government's treatment of farming families has been described to us over and over: uninvited attempts to access farms, security brought to press an elderly landholder, and Greg Baldwin charged after ringing triple zero about trespassers on his own farm. The DPP withdrew every charge on 27 April 2026.

The minister responsible resigned this week without a word of apology. That closes nothing.

Apologise to the families.

Order an independent investigation into the targeting of farmers.

Or deny it on the record, over your own name.

Until one of those happens, this campaign continues, and it is growing.

Yours sincerely,
